git_dir.description: Path to the git directory (.bare for wtx clone, .git for wtx init projects)

worktree_dir.description: Directory holding worktrees: relative to the project root, absolute, or ~/... (~/.wtx/... honors $WTX_HOME). Defaults to worktrees; for git_dir: .git projects, ~/.wtx/<name>/worktrees per clone

shared_dir.description: Directory holding copy/ and symlink/; scripts live in a bin/ next to it. Same path rules as worktree_dir. Defaults to shared; for git_dir: .git projects, ~/.wtx/<name>/shared per clone

main_branch.description: Primary branch (branch ref protected from deletion, used as base for new branches unless wtx add --base-branch is given)

editor.description: Preferred editor binary name for wtx open (e.g. cursor, code, zed); falls back to $EDITOR, then auto-detects

setup.description: Commands to run sequentially after creating a worktree

parallel_setup.description: Commands to run concurrently after serial setup hooks

teardown.description: Commands to run sequentially before removing a worktree

parallel_teardown.description: Commands to run concurrently after serial teardown hooks

background_setup.description: Run setup hooks in the background; override per command with --background or --foreground

scripts.description: Named executables for wtx run <name>: relative to the project root, absolute, or ~/...; executables in bin/ run by name without an entry

disk_warn.description: Warn when free disk space is low (false disables)

disk_warn_percent.description: Warn below this percentage of free space (-1 disables this bound)

disk_warn_gb.description: Warn below this many GB of free space (-1 disables this bound)
